# Assessment Submission Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the submission requirements are explicit, evidence-bound and owned by the human candidate.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the deliverables required by the assessment enumerated by section reference? [Completeness, Spec §CST-003; ASMT §5] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the submission channel specified (GitHub repository, annotated tag `assessment-submission-v1.0`) with what a reviewer receives? [Completeness, Spec §CST-009 (CR-003)] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the reviewer path specified (setup → tests → three scenarios → evidence) with a time target? [Measurability, PVT-009; Spec §SC-010] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it required that the submission discloses limitations, deferred items and demonstration-only metrics? [Completeness, CON IX; Spec §CST-008] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it required that the submission contains no confidential assessment text? [Completeness, Spec §CST-004] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Is a mapping for reviewers specified (assessment section → requirement → evidence)? [Gap, ASMT §6] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is final submission defined as a human-only action, with its recorded approval artifact? [Clarity, CON III; Plan §5.2] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is it required that every completion claim in the submission cites evidence? [Clarity, CON XI] [D31] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the README section "How AI assistance was used and governed" specified with its minimum content? [Clarity, Spec §CST-009 (CR-003); CON X] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Is it specified what the submission discloses if must-have items are incomplete at the timebox deadline? [Coverage, Spec §CST-005; Plan §14.4 STOP-5] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
